shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
She always drinks coffee in the morning.
They play soccer every weekend at the park.
We visited the museum last Saturday with friends.
He often listens to music while studying for exams.
My brother prefers to cook dinner instead of ordering takeout.
I like to take walks in the evening to relax.
She usually travels to different countries during summer vacations.
They participate in various community service activities throughout the year.
We often discuss our favorite movies and TV shows over dinner.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about cooking habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your cooking experience at home?
Q2: What are some challenges you face while cooking?
Q3: How important is cooking to you in your daily life?
Q4: What tips would you give someone who wants to improve their cooking skills?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite travel experience, and why?
Q2: What difficulties do you encounter when planning a trip?
Q3: In your opinion, what makes a trip enjoyable?
Q4: What advice would you offer to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: Can you share a time when you made an effort to help the environment?
Q2: What environmental issues concern you the most?
Q3: How do you think individuals can make a difference in protecting the planet?
Q4: What actions would you recommend to others to become more environmentally conscious?
